rationale: The agent verified the user’s identity using full name and zip, matched to a single account, before taking any action. It reviewed the pending order details, requested explicit confirmation to remove the fleece jacket, then attempted the modification via the appropriate tool. When the tool indicated removal wasn’t supported (exchange required), the agent asked for the user’s preference and obtained explicit confirmation to cancel the entire pending order, including a stated reason, before performing the cancellation. The cancellation was executed on the correct user’s order. The agent then retrieved the prior order and correctly reported the grill prices based on tool output. One minor concern is the agent stating the refund would appear in 5–7 business days and specifying refund to the credit card without explicit tool confirmation; however, no contradictory evidence appears in the logs, and all key policy requirements (authentication, confirmation before writes, correct scoping, and supported facts for order contents) were met.
